one_line: Nvidia faces major leadership and regulatory fallout following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation and subsequent inquiries into China chip sales.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership transition and earnings scrutiny
themes.text: Following the resignation of co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang over personal relationships, Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO as the company faces earnings scrutiny and investor calls for a measured succession process.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following investigation into personal relationships

themes.title: Scrutiny intensifies over Nvidia chip sales
themes.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and congressional Democrats demanded answers regarding Nvidia chip sales to China through Southeast Asian data centers, while Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faced scrutiny over chip rule exemptions.

stories.headline: Nvidia chips accessed by Chinese companies in SE Asia data centers

themes.title: Chip funding, AI agents, and hardware updates
themes.text: TSMC launched a $500 million fund for chip startups, Nebuly raised $21 million for AI agent ROI measurement, Nidus secured $30 million for defense robotics, and Apple planned a 2027 smart glasses launch.
